title: Lava Generator
subtitle: Burns lava, no ash
text:
The Lava Generator holds 4000 mB of lava. Fill it with lava buckets in its left slot, which come back empty on the right, or pipe lava into any side.

It burns 1 mB every 10 ticks, so a bucket runs 500 s. 80 FE/t on iron, 120 FE/t on steel. It stores 80k FE and gives out up to 400 FE/t to every side.

The lava stays in the tank only while the machine stands; breaking it loses the lava.
